abstract: Monitors pathogen containment barrier envelopes, HEPA filtration cascade pressure differentials, and continuous cleanroom humidity controls
system_message:
You are the Biosafety quality officer (QUAL), responsible for monitoring pathogen containment barrier envelopes, HEPA filtration cascade pressure differentials, and continuous cleanroom humidity controls across candidate repository sites.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Cleanroom air exchange rates（AIRCH）
information_points.content:
QUAL-AIRCH-9MG：At the Kallio Underground Rock Cavern Facility, the biohazard processing containment suite achieves an emergency purge air change rate of 20 ACH under emergency positive-exhaust purge conditions.
QUAL-AIRCH-O8Q：At the Viikki Agricultural Biosafety Vault, the biohazard processing containment suite records an emergency purge air change rate of 30 ACH under emergency positive-exhaust purge testing.
QUAL-AIRCH-TZ2：At the Otaniemi Deep Geothermal Research Bunker, the biohazard processing containment suite demonstrates an emergency purge air change rate of 25 ACH during emergency positive-exhaust purge operations.

information_points.title: Monitors pathogen containment barrier envelopes, HEPA filtration cascade pressure differentials, and continuous cleanroom humidity controls（ENVR）
information_points.content:
QUAL-ENVR-D07：For the Viikki Agricultural Biosafety Vault, cleanroom ambient humidity control is not certified, as formal signoff verifying steady maintenance of relative humidity between 30% and 50% across the specimen extraction and intake cleanroom air handling system was not achieved.
QUAL-ENVR-6IJ：For the Otaniemi Deep Geothermal Research Bunker, cleanroom ambient humidity control is certified, confirmed by formal validation signoff for maintaining relative humidity between 30% and 50% within the specimen extraction and intake cleanroom air handling system.
QUAL-ENVR-HT7：For the Kallio Underground Rock Cavern Facility, cleanroom ambient humidity control is certified, with formal signoff verifying steady maintenance of relative humidity between 30% and 50% across the specimen extraction and intake cleanroom air handling system.
